title: Blood Axe: Oath of Vengeance .. Looking for feedback
author: Extreme_Economist914
selftext:
[https://knickoftime.itch.io/blood-axe-oath-of-vengeance](https://knickoftime.itch.io/blood-axe-oath-of-vengeance)

I’ve wanted to make a video game my whole life, and I finally did it with AI tools and no coding or art background. It’s called Blood Axe, a 90s-style hack-and-slash in the spirit of Golden Axe, with fast combat, way too much gore, and a classic revenge story.

It’s an alpha, about 40% done. Level 1 is nearly polished, the other five levels are built but rough, and the music is placeholder for now. It plays best with a controller on PC, right in your browser, free.

I’d love your honest take: what feels good, what feels bad, and what breaks. No account needed.

comments.author: Dry-Amount-5697
comments.body:
Looks like crap. Now that people can people can spend less time on coding - you really need to be extremely critical and precise with art direction. This looks like something a 12 year old would find impressive (maybe like 10 years ago as well).

Not good, just looking at visual vomit.

comments.body: I can just hear Claude now "Juice is what we need, make em bounce and flash. Did you add hit stop. Ahh we are cooking now"

comments.author: LegendaryJohnny
comments.body:
I saw few games here today with same problem which you must sort yourself - spritesheet of move sets. You just prompted AI to create you 2D character moveset sheet and it looks exactly like that - there is no movement of any characters, legs are not moving.

this is something AI cannot do yet, so you must find like real workflow for that type of animation.
